note: Throwaway spike: does an x402 facilitator on Arc Testnet accept an ERC-1271 payer? Testnet only; keys live outside the repository.

transactions.what: x402 payment from the 1271 contract, settled by Circle Facilitator Service (keyless trial)
x402 payment from the 1271 contract, settled by the self-hosted stock @x402/evm facilitator
x402 payment from Wrapped1271 (97-byte signature), settled by Circle Facilitator Service (keyless trial)
x402 payment from Wrapped1271 (97-byte signature), settled by the self-hosted stock @x402/evm facilitator

circleTrial.summary: Circle /settle calls for this payTo on Arc Testnet: 1 (first payment) + 177 (probe, all success) + 1 (probe, settlement_pending, later completed per /status and on chain) + 1 (Wrapped1271) = 180. registration_required was never returned, so the trial allowance is above 180 settles / 0.18 USDC. Its actual size is still unknown.

circleFacilitator1271.auth: keyless trial (Facilitator-Seller-Proof), no Circle account or API key
circleFacilitator1271.client: stock @x402/evm 2.25.0 ExactEvmScheme; only the signer is ours (address = the contract, the owner key signs)

selfHostedFacilitator1271.note: a 65-byte signature is split and sent through the v,r,s overload (0xe3ee160e); a 97-byte one goes through the bytes overload (0xcf092995). USDC checks ERC-1271 on both.

preSimulation.note: presim.mjs: before any funds, eth_call with the contract code overlaid at a test address -- the owner-signed transfer succeeds, a stranger-signed one reverts "FiatTokenV2: invalid signature"
